# Simplero

All-in-one marketing software for course creators, coaches and online marketers.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/simplero/.

## Actions

- **Add Tag to Contact**: Add a tag to a contact identified by email address.
- **Create or Update Administrator**: Create a new administratorship or update an existing one with the same email.
- **Create or Update Contact**: Create a new contact or update an existing contact with the same email.
- **Find Contact By Email** (read-only): Find and retrieve a contact by email address.
- **Find Subscription By Email** (read-only): Find subscriptions for a specific list by email address.
- **Get Admin Roles** (read-only): Retrieve all available admin roles for the account including custom roles.
- **Get Administrators** (read-only): Retrieve all administratorships for the account.
- **Get All Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all mailing lists configured in the account.
- **Get Contact By ID** (read-only): Retrieve a JSON representation of a contact by internal ID.
- **Get Products** (read-only): List all products in the account.
- **Remove Administrator**: Delete an administratorship by ID.
- **Remove Tag from Contact**: Remove a tag from a contact identified by email address.
- **Subscribe to List**: Add a new subscriber to a specific mailing list.
- **Unsubscribe From List**: Unsubscribe a customer from a specific mailing list.
- **Update Contact Credentials**: Update a contact's login credentials including email, first name, and last name.
- **Bulk Subscribe to List**: Add multiple subscribers to a list in a single asynchronous request (max 1,000 per request).
- **Get Administrator By ID** (read-only): Retrieve a single administratorship by internal ID.
- **Get Async Request Status** (read-only): Check the status of an asynchronous API request.
- **Get Invoices** (read-only): Get invoice information with optional filtering by date and invoice number.
